translations.web: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
translations.bsb: “I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?
